newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed on hard currencies after Wednesday's fairly active interbank trading session, dealers said.
"We saw quite an interesting market today with some good two way trade," one dealer said, adding:
"But the inflows -- mainly tobacco and call money -- tended to outweigh the outflows, so the Reserve Bank came in to buy quite a bit.

He said the central bank drained off enough U.S. dollars from the market to bring the local currency back to Tuesday's closing level of 11.3100/3200 against the U.S. currency after it appreciated to 11.3075/3175 at one point.
"It seems they are happier at this (11.3100/3200) rate," the dealer said.
Against sterling, the Zimbabwe dollar finished firmer at 18.5075/5375 from 18.5300/5500, while on the mark it was at 6.5880/5980 compared to 6.5900/6100.
The unit however eased a little versus South Africa's rand to 2.5140/5160 from 2.5000/5200.
